profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Amazon | Specialized in Agentic AI Systems & Distributed Architecture
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Backend Software Engineer with 6 years building AI-powered production systems and distributed architectures at Amazon. Proven track record in architecting end-to-end agentic AI solutions, building distributed systems and driving product direction through technical innovation. Deep expertise in LLM-based systems, microservices architecture, and system design, delivering 2,000+ hours/week operational efficiency gains and serving 1,000+ daily users.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Pioneered a GenAI-powered analytics platform for Amazon retail, automating analysis for 1,000+ internal users and delivering 2,000+ hours/week in operational efficiency.
- Led the transition from monolithic prompts to a modular agentic architecture, enabling autonomous agents to execute multi-dimensional data analysis via dynamic code generation and skill-based tool calling.
- Launched the "Shoppable Image" feature and optimized runtime performance, contributing $100M in annual incremental revenue.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Architected a distributed notification infrastructure for Alexa Together, orchestrating end-to-end lifecycle communications and intelligent alerting for acoustic event detection
- Engineered an extensible multi-channel system with adaptive routing and automatic fallback, reliably processing 2M+ monthly notifications with high availability.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Developed a real-time streaming service using Kinesis Video Streams and Step Functions for AI-based fraud detection.
- Automated GDPR-compliant call redaction, resulting in $13M in annual operational savings.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a distributed web-scraping and automation engine to streamline real-time title searches, reducing manual processing time by 95% and improving data accuracy by 35%.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Engineered high-throughput data pipelines using Spark and MapReduce to process 3TB of daily ad metrics for 1,000+ advertisers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack development (Ruby on Rails/PostgreSQL) for scalable web platforms, driving a 300% growth in membership conversions through workflow optimization.
